list.title: Weekly reports
list.subtitle: Your branch's weekly collection reports. This week's draft is always here: log collections during the week, then submit it for review.
list.headOfficeSubtitle: Weekly collection reports from every branch. Filter by status, branch or week; the filters stay in the address so you can share the view.
list.weekHint: Pick a Monday. Any other day is ignored.
list.caption: Weekly reports
list.emptyBody: No report matches these filters. Try another status, branch or week.

review.title: Review queue
review.subtitle: Submitted reports from every branch, oldest first. Open one to check its collections, then approve it or return it with a reason.
review.caption: Reports waiting for review, oldest first
review.emptyBody: Submitted reports appear here, oldest first, as soon as a branch submits one.
review.waitingDays: {count, plural, =0 {Submitted today} one {Waiting {days} day} other {Waiting {days} days}}

detail.liveTotalHint: Changes as collections are logged or voided, until the report is submitted.
detail.frozenTotalHint: Fixed when the report was submitted. Collections can no longer change it.
detail.collectionCount: {count, plural, =0 {No collections} one {{total} collection} other {{total} collections}}
detail.collectionsEmpty: No collections were logged for this week
detail.collectionsEmptyBody: A report with no collections can still be submitted as a nil report.
detail.historyEmpty: Not submitted yet. Every submission, return and approval will be listed here.
detail.timelineBody: Every recorded change to this report and its collections, oldest first.
detail.returnReasonNext: Fix the collections if needed, then resubmit the report.
detail.lockedBody: This report and its collections can no longer be changed.
detail.readOnlyNotice: You can view every report. Only the branch lead submits, and only a Finance Reviewer returns or approves.
detail.waitingReview: Submitted. A Finance Reviewer will approve it or return it with a reason.
detail.waitingSubmission: The branch has not submitted this report yet.
detail.branchClosedNotice: This branch is closed, so its reports can no longer change.

actions.title: Actions
actions.confirmSubmitBody: The total of {amount} from {count} will be frozen and sent to Finance for review.
actions.nilBody: No collections were logged for this week. Submitting now tells Finance that the branch collected nothing.
actions.nilConfirmLabel: I confirm the branch collected nothing this week
actions.nilRequired: Tick the box to confirm a nil report.
actions.confirmApproveBody: {branch} will be approved at {amount}. The report and its collections will then be locked for good.
actions.returnBody: The branch lead sees your reason and can fix the collections before resubmitting.
actions.returnReasonHint: Between 3 and 500 characters. Say exactly what needs to change.
actions.done: Saved. The report now shows its new status.

errors.invalid_transition: Someone else has already acted on this report. It now shows its current status.
errors.self_approval: You submitted this report, so someone else must approve it.
errors.totals_mismatch: The collections changed after submission, so the totals no longer match. Return the report so the branch can resubmit it.
errors.branch_closed: This branch is closed, so its reports can no longer change.
errors.nil_confirmation_required: This report has no collections. Confirm that it is a nil report to submit it.
errors.too_long: Keep the reason to 500 characters or fewer.
errors.generic: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
